name: Talia Wichzini
caption: WWP's own in-fiction head of the front office, a veteran of women's wrestling whose own tough front-office style dictates the fed's own harsh, no-nonsense approach.

name: Naomi Ishikawa
caption: Billed as a five-year veteran of joshi puroresu; serves as Talia Wichzini's VP and the wrestlers' own advocate within WWP's front office.
